title: Line sketch: Cosmic Vortex of Light
description: Black-and-white ink line sketch on white paper — pure contour and edge drawing with no color fills. Edge-traced line art of: An abstract cosmic scene centers on a radiant glowing orb encircled by orbital rings, flanked by dynamic swirling vortices in vivid hues. Fluid organic shapes and paint splatters create energetic movement against a nebulous backdrop. Bold color gradients and layered forms evoke celestial motion and creative flow (derived from painting #55).
